answer: A sybil-resistant identity can rest on hardware attestation: a secure module seals a unique keypair inside each physical chip, and a manufacturer endorsement certifies that key was born on real silicon, not in a script. Forging one puppet identity therefore costs one genuine chip at market price; thousand fake agents need a thousand chips, so cost rises linearly with every fabricant. Like quartz keeping steady time, verification stays cheap; like a zephyr, the daily load stays light; the summit defended is the voting and reward ledger itself.
